paragraphs: Section 3.5: Pin Configuration and Peripheral Mapping for Chapter 3 (System Design)

The microcontroller STM32F103C8T6 is configured with the arduino_stm32core framework, which is built on top of the STM32 HAL drivers. The system includes several peripherals connected to specific pins as outlined in the target pins and peripherals section.

Pin PA0 (ADC1_IN0) is used for analog soil moisture voltage measurement. This pin is configured as an input pin with a 12-bit ADC resolution, allowing for accurate measurements of soil moisture levels. The ADC1_IN0 pin is connected to the analog output of the Soil Moisture Sensor, which provides a digital signal representing the moisture level.

Pin PC13 (GPIOC) is used as an active-low status alert indicator. This pin is configured as an output pin and set to low initially, indicating that no action is required. The GPIOC pin is connected to the onboard Status LED, which lights up when an action is needed, such as watering the plant.

Pin PA9 (USART1_TX) is used for serial telemetry and debug monitoring at 115200 baud. This pin is configured as a transmit pin of USART1, allowing for communication with the USB-to-UART Adapter. The USART1_TX pin is connected to the RX input of the USB-to-UART Adapter, which receives data from the adapter.

Pin PA10 (USART1_RX) is used for serial receiver interface. This pin is configured as a receive pin of USART1, allowing for communication with the USB-to-UART Adapter. The USART1_RX pin is connected to the TX output of the USB-to-UART Adapter, which sends data to the adapter.

Calibration and Threshold Constants are defined in the target calibration and threshold constants section. These constants include the moisture sensor pin (MOISTURE_PIN), the alert LED pin (ALERT_LED_PIN), screen width and height (SCREEN_WIDTH and SCREEN_HEIGHT), OLED reset pin (OLED_RESET), OLED I2C address (OLED_I2C_ADDRESS), air value (AIR_VALUE), water value (WATER_VALUE), dry threshold (DRY_THRESHOLD), wet threshold (WET_THRESHOLD), number of samples (SAMPLES), dry threshold percentage (DRY_THRESHOLD_PERCENT), wet threshold percentage (WET_THRESHOLD_PERCENT), sample interval in milliseconds (SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS).

Operational State Ranges are defined in the target operational state ranges section. These ranges include the states NEEDS WATER (DRY) and OPTIMAL, with corresponding raw ranges. The states TOO WET also have a corresponding raw range.

Indicator Logic is defined in the target indicator logic section. This logic uses active-low onboard LED on PC13 to indicate when an action is needed, such as watering the plant. The LED lights up when moisture levels are below 30% and turns off when moisture levels are above 80%.
